limitations: 20 section observations, 18 unique game URLs, five unique detail inspections. Bloxd.io and Boxity.io occur in both sections. Duplicate exposures retained without summing metrics.
Homepage US label is not a global ranking; DOM order is not an official rank. Bounded nonrandom sample.
Hot page monthly title conflicts with last-24-hours introduction. No unified time window inferred.
Missing metrics are null, not zero. Uninspected games do not inherit old metrics or descriptions. Ratings, votes, plays, users and directory sizes remain distinct.

19 unique cover URL representations downloaded locally and fully decoded as AVIF, size and SHA-256 verified. HTTP status and response Content-Type unavailable in supported browser API. All 20 cover records verification_incomplete, with null repository paths and successful download metadata. No cover files eligible for publication.
Five new Chinese descriptions cover seven section records through same-run identity reuse; 13 records lack gameplay evidence and retain null descriptions.
Release-date conflicts preserved without expanding date precision. Openfront developer not observed and retained null.

Only cloud browser and GitHub connector used for source acquisition. Offline local Python used solely for byte verification and JSON assembly. No user computer, hidden APIs, active gameplay, votes or video downloads. Embedded games may auto-load.
